what_worked: Contrarian thesis (unit economics over hype) is a genuinely interesting angle with purposeful narrative arc.
fix_next: Ground every claim in the actual 1,000-row dataset; disclose sample selection, missingness, and composite-score methodology transparently.
verdict: Polished consulting theater built on fabricated numbers; thesis is unearned.
factual_error_detail: S1: AI count 35 vs actual 197; Marketing 15 vs 42; SaaS 12 vs 66; Education 9 vs 30; '16 primary sectors' unverifiable. S2: Dev Tools median $31,125 vs reference $635 (~49x inflated); Education median $30,903 vs $2,435 (~13x); composite scores (67.08, 66.28, 63.84, 62.57, 50.57) have zero disclosed methodology. S3: 'Games' and 'Marketplace' are not recognized categories in the reference data—appear fabricated. S5: Dev Tools $105.67 Rev/Sub and $0.90 Rev/Visitor unverifiable from reference. S6: AI median rev $22,571 vs reference median $503 (~45x inflated); AI count again 35 vs 197. S7: Stan and Supliful figures cannot be verified against reference but MRR > 30-day Rev for Stan ($3.57M vs $2.84M) is suspicious without explanation.

evidence.insight: The volume≠value thesis and AI-hype-vs-substance framing are conceptually interesting but entirely performative—every supporting number appears fabricated or drawn from an undisclosed sub-sample, so no insight is actually earned from the data.
evidence.narrative: Clear arc from overview → quality screen → velocity → funnel → efficiency → AI vs SaaS → outliers → recommendations. Sequence is purposeful and builds to actionable conclusion. Undermined fatally by unverifiable data foundation.
evidence.framing: No dataset description, no mention of 1,000 rows, no disclosure of 274 missing categories or 288 missing audience_type. 'Verified Startup Index' implies curated sub-sample but never explains selection criteria, sample size, or filtering logic. Cold reader has no way to assess scope or limitations.
evidence.accuracy: Category counts wrong by 5-10x across all four named categories. Median revenues inflated by 10-50x. Games and Marketplace appear as phantom categories not in reference. Composite quality scores presented to two decimal places with zero methodology. Derived metrics (MRR ratios, Rev/Sub, Rev/Visitor) are unverifiable. Systematic pattern of fabrication rather than honest error.
evidence.visual: Clean, consistent design language with effective color-coding (green/blue/red tiers). Scatter plot on slide 5 is well-constructed. Funnel-vs-cylinder metaphor on slide 4 is creative. Gauge charts are decorative but readable. Dot counts on slides 5-6 don't match stated sample sizes. Overall professional appearance.
evidence.ai_slop: Heavy consulting-speak: 'Aggregate Alpha,' 'Capital Deployment Playbook,' 'The Substance Play,' 'picks-and-shovels play,' 'Investment Thesis,' 'Alpha Cohort.' Composite scores with false precision (67.08, 66.28) and no methodology are classic AI-generated authoritative filler. NotebookLM watermark on every slide. Language pattern is generic enough to fit any startup dataset.

change_reason: Lowered insight from 5→4.5 because the thesis, while conceptually interesting, is entirely unearned from the data. Lowered framing from 3.5→3 for complete absence of dataset description and sample methodology. Lowered accuracy from 2→1.5 reflecting systematic fabrication across 14+ verifiable errors including phantom categories and 10-50x median inflation. Raised visual slightly from 5→5.5 for genuinely clean design execution despite decorative elements. Narrative unchanged at 5.5.
